top_signals.title: Glencore Profit Jumps on Trading Boom and Record Copper
top_signals.summary: Glencore Plc reported a steep jump in profits after a surge in the price of its most important commodities and its trading unit had one of its best ever periods as the Iran war sent energy prices soaring.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
